description: Reusable semantic surface families for WORLD PACKS. Families classify presentation surfaces by their canonical physical anchor; they never define, mutate or override Matter truth, strata depth or physical material properties.

families.physical_anchor: Unconsolidated to compacted granular mantle derived from mechanical breakdown of the parent rock body.
Coherent to fractured fine-grained mafic silicate rock exposed as bedrock or boulder surfaces.
Loose well-sorted granular sand-sized particles transportable by wind or water.
families.pending_reason: No canonical matter/sand material exists in matter_material_catalog today; binding unrelated loose or silicate matter (e.g. matter/regolith-loose, matter/silicate-waste) as sand would be an ambiguous physical binding and MUST fail.
families.pending_unblock: Canonical Matter ownership introduces a sand/granular matter id; then this family binds it explicitly in matter_binding_rules.

families.physical_anchor: Bonded crystalline water-ice surfaces from polar caps, icy regolith cement or exposed ice bodies.
